C0607.title: Anhui Police Warn: Canceling a Mobile Number Is Like Selling Yourself, Sparking Debate
C0607.summary: In April 2024, a police officer from Tongling, Anhui, posted an educational video warning that casually discarded mobile numbers can be used by others to log into various apps via SMS verification codes, leading to financial loss and privacy breaches.
